newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.
newsitem.headline: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Thursday, as technical buying by individual investors emerged following price falls earlier this week, traders said.
Prices were up 80 to 360 yen, with the benchmark January 1998 contract up 180 yen at 14,470 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 51,210 lots.

Local investors engaged in technical buying, supporting all months from the opening, traders said. "Some investors hold many short positions in distant months, and are looking for better timing to cover them," a brokerage house trader said.
As of 0745 GMT, the spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A system was last traded at $2.59-1/4 per bushel, unchanged from Wednesday's Chicago close.
Spot January CBOT soybean futures on Project A were at $6.93-1/2, down from $6.95-1/2.
